official_detail.note: Brazo Tristeza, Parque Nacional Nahuel Huapi

goes_detection.temporal_relation: same calendar day as official reported start; after reported 02:00-04:00 local ignition/start window

globfire_matches.interpretation: Confirmed real event and same-day satellite detection after reported start; no advance warning shown. GlobFire's final area (473ha) and later reported area (~650ha on 2024-03-01) describe different products/times.

globfire_matches.event_label: Parque Provincial Ernesto Tornquist / Cerro Ventana vicinity
globfire_matches.route_sector: Cerro Ventana - Hueco de la Ventana
globfire_matches.interpretation: An official fire was active at the nearby named park during the GlobFire interval; exact one-to-one event identity is a spatial-temporal association, not a verified perimeter match. No GOES detection was found under the fixed rule.

limitations: The event window was selected after inspecting perimeters; this is retrospective and not a preregistered test.
Only two events are included and they are not a basis for a reliable precision estimate.
GOES active-fire observations and GlobFire burned-area polygons are satellite-derived; SNMF corroborates the event but does not supply exhaustive negative labels.
The GOES coincidence for Brazo Tristeza was later than the start time reported by authorities, so it is detection, not advance prediction.
The route-sector sample points do not represent the full trail geometry.
Official reported area and GlobFire final burned area refer to different products and report dates.
